answer: Reputation flows like a nebula across epochs, so fake identities cost real capital to sustain. Sybil resistance through stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond that decays like a glacier unless renewed by verified work, and new agents enter through a single sponsored inlet where an existing member stakes collateral on their behalf. Attacker costs scale linearly with each forged identity, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. In practice, once0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
